statement: The reader accepts a VliqT carrying a PRESSURE unit, silently: `VliqT 50 Pa;` is read as 50 K (CH4 at 105 K then prints 369.12 kg/m3 and announces "Vliq at 50.0000 K"), and `VliqT [1 -1 -2 0 0] 111.66;` is read as 111.66 K. Component.cpp:139 reads the key with lookupScalar("VliqT") and no expected dimension, so a declared dimension is never checked. Same posture as the record's other unitless keys (Tc, Tb), but a new key whose whole content is a temperature is the place a wrong dimension should refuse.
evidence: reader_probes.tsv rows R07, R09 (reader_probes.py; one scratch case per probe, rho_liquid_CH4 from choupoProps)
reproduced_twice: yes (two full probe runs, identical verdicts)

statement: No lower bound: `VliqT 1e-3;` (one millikelvin) on CH4 is accepted and used as the datum temperature (rho_liquid_CH4 at 105 K = 332.93 kg/m3). The reader refuses <= 0 and >= Tc only; a datum temperature at which the record has no liquid is not refused or announced.

The percentages the design note (table, line 55: "the engine's 25 C density is +13 %, +19 %, +7 %, +4 %") and evidence.tsv give for Cl2, H2S, SO2, nButane are relative to a handbook point carried by Rackett, not what the engine's own correction does: the branch changes the engine's 298.15 K density by +11.38 %, +21.32 %, +6.71 %, +5.06 % (engine and an independent script agree to the printed digit). For nButane, measured saturated density (ThermoML) says the parent line was +5.42 % too dense at 298.15 K, not +4 %. Directions and order of magnitude hold; the numbers as written do not reproduce from the engine.

evidence.tsv nButane row says the stored value belongs to "about 276 (Tb 272.65)"; measured saturated volumes put the stored 96.2 cm3/mol at 269.92 K (2.7 K BELOW the assigned Tb, not 3 K above). The assignment VliqT 272.65 holds (stored -0.49 % of measured there); the evidence column's estimate is on the wrong side.

Propane, pinned unresolved, IS resolved by the mirror: the stored 84.2 cm3/mol equals the measured saturated-liquid volume at 276.65 K (two articles agree to 0.03 %), so it is not a volume at Tb (+10.92 % of the measured volume at 231.02 K). The evidence's Rackett estimate (282.9 K) is 6.3 K from measurement. The engine today prints 523.71 kg/m3 at 298.15 K against a measured 492.27 (+6.39 %); with a case-local `VliqT 276.65;` it prints 491.99 (-0.06 %).

Propylene, pinned unresolved ("unknown"), belongs to the boiling-point class by measurement: the stored 68.1 cm3/mol equals the measured saturated volume at 219.12 K and is -1.27 % of the measured volume at the record's Tb 225.46 K (the other Tb-class records sit within 2.1 %). The engine today prints 617.93 kg/m3 at 298.15 K against a measured 506.15 (+22.08 %), the largest density error of all 26 records the mirror can check; VliqT 225.46 would give +1.62 %, VliqT 219.12 +0.36 % (independent Rackett script). One article only.
